rule: Why a parsed notice is kept, or None. In order: - not kept: a cancellation; a window over MAX_DAYS; text naming general aviation or aerobatics; - "words": notam.LAUNCH_WORDS in the E) text (aerospace, rocket, space debris, reentry, stage, missile...) or a Q-code of subject WM (missile, gun or rocket firing): notam.parse's own launch_related; - "cn-area": a Chinese FIR (Q-line or A), notam.FIR_STATE CN), Q-code in CN_AREA_CODES, upper limit unlimited, and a window of at most CN_MAX_HOURS, or one of at most CN_MAX_DAYS whose D) periods are each at most CN_MAX_PERIOD_HOURS.
